User: I think I would say Chick-fil-A sandwich, chicken sandwich, crispy or spicy Chick-fil-A sandwich. I like how it's chicken. I like how it just has a really consistent taste. The only thing I don't like better is I like the sides and stuff you might get from the McDonald's, sometimes a little better. Sometimes I'd rather have the fries, but even though I do really like Chick-fil-A fries, it's kind of really almost a tie. And my second one would have to be maybe like something, maybe like breakfast from Chick-fil-A, I would have to say. So like one of those wraps, chicken wraps.
Agent: Okay, so a Chick-fil-A crispy or spicy chicken sandwich is one. You appreciate its consistent chicken taste, though you sometimes prefer McDonald's sides and fries.
